envelope.description: Size refusals are recognised on every CLI failure path and never retried

body.title: Size refusals are recognised on every CLI failure path and never retried
body.summary: Add classifyInputTooLarge and InputTooLargeError (a CliExitError with maxChars/actualChars) and apply them at runCodex's error/turn.failed check, cliExitError and the claude is_error envelope check; CliProvider.withTransientRetry and withStructuredRetry rethrow an InputTooLargeError at once.
acceptanceChecks: codex input_too_large on any of its failure paths and a claude 'Prompt is too long' envelope each surface an InputTooLargeError from completeStructured after exactly one CLI run, with maxChars/actualChars when reported.
Error messages are unchanged; other errors are retried as today.

tests.name: src/agent/providers/__tests__/input-too-large.test.ts: 'codex input_too_large becomes an InputTooLargeError with maxChars and actualChars; the message is unchanged'
src/agent/providers/__tests__/input-too-large.test.ts: 'withStructuredRetry rethrows an InputTooLargeError after one call'

src/agent/providers/__tests__/input-too-large-cli.test.ts: 'a fake codex emitting an input_too_large error event, or exiting non-zero with it on stderr, and a fake claude returning an is_error Prompt is too long envelope each surface an InputTooLargeError from completeStructured after one run'
src/agent/providers/__tests__/input-too-large-cli.test.ts: 'a size refusal whose text also matches the transient classifier (API Error: Prompt is too long) runs the CLI once'
